source.paper: T. S. Thakur, L. Ercole, N. Marzari, Novel fast Li-ion conductors for solid-state electrolytes from first-principles, Energy Environ. Sci. 2026, doi:10.1039/d5ee07336g
source.read_from: arXiv:2601.03151v1 PDF (43 pp, main text pp 1-21, SI pp 22-43)
source.ees_si: not fetched: pubs.rsc.org is outside the allowed fetch hosts (hard rule 3); the arXiv PDF carries the SI (MSD plots S1-S43, no tables, no numeric class criterion)

stages.count_source: Fig. 3 node labels COD 8,007 + ICSD 8,917 + MPDS 13,305 (text: approximately 8,000, 9,000, and 13,000)
stages.name: sources
stages.method: repository query, CIF import with AiiDA
stages.verbatim_span: Starting from experimental structures sourced from the Crystallography Open Database (COD), Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD) and Materials Platform for Data Science (MPDS) repositories, we identify more than 30,000 lithium containing structures, which are imported as CIF files using AiiDA.

stages.name: clean
stages.observable: CIF parses after COD-tools cleaning (Mounet et al. protocol)
stages.verbatim_span: We follow that protocol to clean, parse and standardise CIF files using COD-tools

stages.count_source: Fig. 3 "Integer occupancy 12,198", "Partial occupancy 9,532", "Li only partial occupancy 1,112" (text: approximately 10,600 removed, 12,000 remain)
stages.name: occupancy
stages.verbatim_span: We remove structures with partial occupancies i.e. those whose stoichiometry doesn't align with the reported atomic positions

rule_gap.what: matcher tolerances not stated (Sec 1: "tightening the tolerances")
rule_gap.frozen_reading: not reconstructed (parent CIFs not deposited; ICSD/MPDS licensed)

stages.name: unicity
stages.method: pymatgen StructureMatcher (CMPZ algorithm), same stoichiometry only
stages.verbatim_span: we use the CMPZ algorithm implemented within the structure matcher function of pymatgen to compare crystal structures with the same stoichiometry, to eliminate equivalent structures and retain only unique ones.

rule_gap.what: "a specific selection of anions" is not enumerated; "heavier than Polonium" comparator (Po itself) unstated; Sc and Zn membership in "3d-transition" unstated
rule_gap.frozen_reading: exclude Z > 84 (Po kept), exclude Sc-Zn, require >= 1 of N P As Sb Bi O S Se Te F Cl Br I. Checked on deposited survivors only (consistency, not a recount).

stages.name: composition

exclude: noble gases (He Ne Ar Kr Xe Rn)
threshold.require: anions from the pnictogen, chalcogen and halogen families ("a specific selection")

stages.verbatim_span: we filter out those with hydrogen, as elements lighter than lithium cannot be correctly modelled by the pinball approximation; those containing noble gas atoms; 3d-transition elements, due to their potential to changing oxidation states during simulations and become electronically conducting; and elements heavier than Polonium. Furthermore, we apply additional filtering criteria to ensure that each structure contains a specific selection of anions from the pnictogen, chalcogen and halogen families.

stages.name: atomic_distance
stages.observable: pair distances typical of organic bonds
stages.threshold: bond lengths "typically associated with organic molecules such as double bond with O or triple bond with N"
stages.verbatim_span: For each structure, we calculate the bond distances between every atom pair that is compatible with inorganic materials to filter out structures with bond lengths typically associated with organic molecules such as double bond with O or triple bond with N.

stages.count_source: text p7 and Fig. 5 ("Electronic insulators 982", "Electronic conductors 478")
stages.span_source: Sec 3 p7; Sec 2.2 p5 ("band gap greater than 1 eV as electronically insulating")
stages.name: electronic
stages.observable: Kohn-Sham band gap at experimental geometry
stages.method: pw.x SCF, SSSP efficiency 1.2.1, MV cold smearing, k density 0.15 1/Å, +20% bands
stages.verbatim_span: we classify a structure as an electronic insulator if its band gap exceeds 1 eV. Out of the 1,499 unique structures, 982 are identified as electronic insulators, and 39 calculations failed

stages.name: scf_rerun
stages.observable: SCF convergence of the band-gap single point
stages.method: rerun with non-linear conjugate gradient (SIRIUS-enabled QE)
stages.verbatim_span: Out of these, 251 calculations fail to converge due to issues in the self-consistent electronic cycle. These are subsequently rerun using the non-linear conjugate gradient method within SIRIUS enabled Quantum ESPRESSO.

stages.count_source: text p8 "Out of 982 structures, we achieve convergence for 914, with failures occurring due to issues in the self-consistent electronic cycle when calculating DFT forces"
stages.name: pinball_selfconsistency
stages.observable: r2 between DFT and pinball forces at converged pinball coefficients
stages.verbatim_span: We ensure that the r2 correlation for the converged pinball coefficients exceeds 0.95, with the majority of cases exceeding 0.99. If this criterion is not met, additional self-consistent pinball MD iterations are performed

rule_gap.what: no drift tolerance stated; no rerun policy stated for drift failures
rule_gap.frozen_reading: drift failures are dropped (the text reports them as failures)

stages.name: pinball_drift
stages.observable: drift in the MD constant of motion
stages.verbatim_span: An additional 63 structures failed the pinball MD simulations due to drift in the constant of motion, leading to 851 structures with a final iteration of the pinball MD run with converged coefficients

rule_gap.what: comparator at exactly 1 mS/cm not stated (">=" vs ">")
rule_gap.frozen_reading: >= ; items within rounding of 1 mS/cm reported apart

stages.count_source: text p8 and Fig. 5 ("Potential fast-diffusers 132", "Non-diffusive structures 738", "Failed calculations 170")
stages.name: pinball_conductivity
stages.observable: Li-ion conductivity from the final pinball MD MSD slope via Nernst-Einstein (H = 1)
stages.verbatim_span: Ionic conductivity of 1 mS/cm at 1000 K is chosen as the threshold to categorise potential fast ionic conductors at the pinball level. At the end of this process, 132 structures are identified for further study using first-principles calculations.

rule_gap.what: judgement by literature review; not computable by code

stages.count_source: text p8 (77 known), Sec 4 p14 ("The remaining 55 materials")
stages.name: novelty
stages.observable: reported in the literature as a Li-ion conductor
stages.verbatim_span: Out of these 132 structures, we rediscover 77 known Li-ion conductors and as such we exclude them from FPMD investigations.

rule_gap.what: no numeric criterion for "do not exhibit Li-ion diffusion" in text or SI
rule_gap.frozen_reading: diffusive iff D_FPMD(1000 K) > 1e-9 cm^2/s. Evidence: Fig. 15 caption "The bold-grey line represents the threshold below which MSD convergence cannot be achieved with FPMD, serving as the lower bound for diffusion"; the line sits on the 10^-9 tick (figure read, not text). Items within one decade of 1e-9 reported apart.

stages.name: fpmd_1000K
stages.observable: Li tracer diffusion at 1000 K from FPMD MSD
stages.method: Born-Oppenheimer MD, 100 ps, 1000 K, NVT SVR
stages.verbatim_span: the structures that exhibit high Li-ion diffusivity at 1000 K with the pinball model are subsequently studied with FPMD at the same temperature for 100 ps. ... We find 18 materials that do not exhibit Li-ion diffusion in our FPMD simulations at 1000 K.

rule_gap.what: escalation condition is the S10 outcome, itself a rule gap
rule_gap.frozen_reading: escalate iff S10 frozen reading says diffusive

stages.count_source: derived: 9 (Table 3) + 25 (Table 2) studied at lower temperatures; exception Li2P2PdO7 only at 600 K (Table 2 footnote **, SI Fig. S15 caption)
stages.name: temperature_ladder
stages.observable: FPMD validates the material as a fast ionic conductor at 1000 K
stages.verbatim_span: The structures validated by FPMD as fast ionic conductors are then studied at three lower temperatures: 750 K , 600 K and 500 K for 125 ps, 150 ps and 180 ps respectively.

rule_gap.what: no numeric criterion separates fast from high_T_only; Li10Si2PbO10 and Li2B3PO8 are in Table 2 yet the text reports their low-T diffusion and barriers
rule_gap.frozen_reading: Outcome class family not built (skill C5: criterion stated, else rule gap); classes used only as deposited labels for reconciliation

stages.name: fpmd_outcome_class

threshold.fast: diffusion resolved at low T, activation barrier estimated (Table 3)
threshold.high_T_only: significant diffusion at 1000 K but not at lower temperatures (Table 2)

stages.verbatim_span: We have identified 25 structures that exhibit significant diffusion at 1000 K in our FPMD simulations, but do not display the same behaviour at lower temperatures. ... These materials are of particular interest due to their potential applications, characterised by their fast ionic conduction, which allows us to resolve Li-ion diffusion even at low temperatures and estimate activation barriers

derived_laws.name: tracer_D
derived_laws.law: D_tr = lim 1/(6t) <MSD(t)> (eq. 1), linear regression of MSD(t)
derived_laws.span: By performing a linear regression of the mean square displacement MSD(t) with time we can accurately estimate the diffusion coefficient from the slope of the MSD

rule_gap.what: fit window (start, end, block averaging) not stated; SAMOS defaults used by the authors
rule_gap.frozen_reading: our msd.py window frozen on synthetic data (C2)

derived_laws.name: nernst_einstein
derived_laws.law: sigma = N (Ze)^2 D_tr / (Omega k_B T H) (eq. 2), H = 1
derived_laws.span: In the dilute limit, we assume it to be 1, though in practice it is often less than 1, implying that correlated motion can enhance conductivity
derived_laws.model_error: Haven ratio fixed at 1 (stated assumption); every T3 stem states it

derived_laws.name: arrhenius
derived_laws.law: ln D = ln D0 - Ea/(k_B T), linear fit over 1000, 750, 600, 500 K
derived_laws.span: The activation barrier for these structures is estimated from a linear fit of the Arrhenius behaviour and the error is obtained with Bayesian propagation

rule_gap.what: whether the fit is on D or on sigma*T, and which temperatures enter, not stated
rule_gap.frozen_reading: fit ln D vs 1/T on the temperatures where D is resolved (Figs. 11-12 plot D vs 1000/T)

derived_laws.name: room_temperature_extrapolation
derived_laws.span: it is important to note that this estimation is based on the extrapolation of the Arrhenius plot, where a change of slope is possible

rule_gap.what: room temperature value (293/298/300 K) not stated

cost_units.definition: cost of 1 ps of Born-Oppenheimer DFT-PBEsol MD on the material supercell

pinball_speedup.span: is on average about 200-500 times faster than DFT

pinball_total_time_us.span: 851 structures with a final iteration of the pinball MD run with converged coefficients and a total simulation time of 22.1 µs

scf_named_default.basis: named default: one SCF single point = one MD step; MD time step not stated, named default 1 fs, so 1 SCF = 0.001 FPMD_ps_eq

cost_units.note: S7_S8 = mean pinball MD time per completed material (22.1 µs / 851) divided by the mid speedup 350; range 52-130 for speedups 500-200. Fitting-workchain DFT force calls are not counted (unstated).
